item.title: Cinola 0.3.6
item.description:
• The player's Info tab shows how many connections are filling the buffer, for example “33 s ahead (2 connections)”: two means the server can't keep up on one and Cinola is fetching ahead on a second; “download paused” means the buffer is full.
  • Audio and subtitle lists show up to four tracks and scroll past that, so the panel stays compact on files with many dubs.

item.title: Cinola 0.3.5
item.description:
• BondMedia is now called Cinola. It's the same app as BondMedia 0.3.5 under a new name.
  • Cinola installs as a new app: sign in to your Jellyfin server again. Settings, the Watchlist and downloads from BondMedia don't carry over, and BondMedia can be deleted.
